page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.margin_note: One line for what it secretes, one for where it lies.
lines: The endostyle is a mucus secreting longitudinal
It lies in the ventral part of the pharynx of
steps.why: The endostyle is named by where it sits and what it makes, and both facts are needed before its use can be explained.
common_mistakes: Placing the endostyle in the gut. It lies in the pharynx.
Calling it dorsal. It runs along the ventral wall of the pharynx.
steps.memory_tip: End of the pharynx floor, making mucus: endostyle.

steps.label: Its importance
steps.margin_note: The two uses are the two marks. Name both, even in a short answer.

lines.text: Food collection · forerunner of the thyroid

lines: 1) It helps in food collection. The mucus traps
the food particles in the water current, and
the food is carried to the gut.
2) It is the forerunner of the thyroid gland of
steps.why: The endostyle carries both marks because it answers two different questions at once — how the animal feeds now, and where a vertebrate gland came from.
common_mistakes: Giving only the feeding use. The thyroid link is the second mark.
Writing that it is the thyroid gland. It is the structure the thyroid gland arose from.
steps.memory_tip: Two uses, one present and one past: it collects food today, and it became the thyroid gland.

insider_note: The thyroid line is the one most students leave out, and it is worth as much as the feeding line.
